question: Raghav starts from Point A and drives 30 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 34 km, turns right and drives 41 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 47 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 11 km and stops at Point P. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point P in a straight line? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
